complete.description: Whether all records have been delivered or not. `false` means there's another page

scroll.description: Scroll token to use for pagination

query.description: The GNQL query string the requester queried

adjusted_query.description:
When certain query parameters are not specified or incompatible
with your current plan, GreyNoise automatically adjusts params on your
query prior to execution.

count.description: The number of total results for the given GNQL query

message.description: A status message indicating if there were issues with the request

restricted_fields.description: The fields that were restricted due to plan limitations
